glossary.section21: An eviction notice a landlord can serve without giving a reason. We flag whether the notice period and grounds are valid.
glossary.section8: An eviction notice the landlord must justify with specific grounds (rent arrears, anti-social behaviour, etc.).
glossary.RTM: Right to Manage — a leaseholders' collective right to take over the management of their building from the landlord.
glossary.LFRA: Leasehold Reform Act — the UK framework most leasehold extensions and freehold acquisitions rely on.
glossary.BSA2022: Building Safety Act 2022 — the post-Grenfell framework for building-safety remediation and leaseholder protection.
glossary.EWS1: External Wall System fire-review certificate — required for buildings over 18m with combustible cladding.
glossary.serviceCharge: The fee a landlord charges a leaseholder for maintaining the building. Must be 'reasonable'.
glossary.groundRent: A periodic rent paid by the leaseholder to the freeholder. Often ground-rent clauses are escalating — we flag the escalation.
glossary.demisedPremises: The part of the building you actually own (your flat). Anything outside this is 'common parts'.
glossary.dampMould: A hazard under the Homes (Fitness for Human Habitation) Act. We flag any clause that waives the landlord's duty to repair.
